posts.name: Aman Kumar
posts.cooked: I got all test cases passed in 1 and 2 BPT of Week 2 but in 3rd I got 2/4 and in 4th I got 2/3. Still in my dashboard it shows 50

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: @Subendu can you clarify what process we are following for BPT?

posts.name: Subendu Gorai
posts.cooked: We are not giving partial marks for BPT. We are giving either 0 or 100—100 if all the test cases pass, otherwise, 0.

posts.name: Aman Kumar
posts.cooked: Sir I know that, my concern is that in BPT is it already difficult to predict what is wrong going on because we are not able to debug and see on the screen our outputs. Then atleast what happens in GrPA grading pattern should happen in this .

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
That is not correct. All BPTs have diff of your output and expected output. You can always see exactly what is the mistake in your output. You should familiarize yourself with how diff works to utilize the synchro eval output to its fullest.

Further as there are only public test cases and no private test cases, giving partial marks does not make sense.
